rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF

positions.name: Direxion Daily Financial Bull 3X
positions.catalyst: The 'Great Rotation of 2026' accelerated on Jul 28: money bailing out of high-flying chips/AI into cyclical & value. SOX -6.4%, Nasdaq tech -3.8% (NVDA -5%, SNDK -11%, AMD -5.2%, SK hynix -7.5%) on fears circular AI-financing arrangements unravel if hyperscalers trim capex. Meanwhile Dow +1.0%, and the Financials SPDR (XLF) AND Health Care (XLV) both closed at RECORD HIGHS, led by insurers/banks. Financials are drawing sustained inflows into Q2 bank-earnings season, with falling oil an added macro tailwind.
positions.driver: LONG 3x US Financials. Chose FAS over the higher-octane semi trades because the dominant momentum edge is the rotation INTO value, not another chase of the extended semi wreck. SOXS (3x inverse semi) is up ~40% over two down days = deep no-chase zone and a landmine into MSFT/META hyperscaler-capex prints Wed after close (a strong capex guide would violently bounce semis and crush a fresh short). SOXL (3x long semi) is a falling knife into that same binary. FAS rides a broad, funded, multi-factor, multi-week trend (XLF+XLV record highs, bank-earnings inflows, falling oil) with far less single-catalyst binary risk and it is NOT extended in no-chase terms (broad-index ~1%/day => ~3% on FAS). 3x justified by the breadth and durability of the rotation. Also weighed spot BTC (no fresh catalyst; edge is clearly in equities today) and cash (not a low-edge day). Hard stop 162.05 (-10%, 3x rule).
positions.risks: 3x daily-reset ETF — decay & gap risk, amplified 3x. Key risk: if the semi/AI unwind metastasizes into a broad risk-off, financials get dragged down too and 3x hits hard. MSFT & META report Wed after close and AAPL/AMZN Thu — a market-wide risk sentiment swing from those prints (held through to the Thu 6:30am CT rotation) can gap FAS either way. Rotation trades can reverse if tech snaps back and money rotates BACK into the megacap winners. Financials also sensitive to a sharp rate/curve move. Entry of record 180.06.
